verificationEvidence.claim: WHAT: The change removes the `AbortSignal.timeout(5000)` option, leaving `fetch(url)` with no timeout. WHY: `fetch` has no built-in timeout, so if the remote host accepts the connection but never responds (or stalls mid-body), the returned promise never settles — every caller awaiting `getJson` hangs indefinitely, leaking the pending request/socket and exhausting resources under repeated calls. This is a regression: the diff deletes the only guard that bounded the wait to 5s. HOW: Restore a timeout, e.g. `const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });` (or pass a configurable timeout).
